notes: All ids verified against assets/artifacts/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. lang keys (45 items). Artifacts is almost entirely loot-driven: the jar contains only 4 recipe files (eternal_steak from everlasting_beef via smelting, smoking and campfire_cooking - the other file is the shared advancement), so every chain 'desc' was derived from data/artifacts/loot_tables/inject/** and the matching data/artifacts/loot_modifiers/inject/** global loot modifiers, which name the exact vanilla chest, archaeology or entity table each artifact is injected into. Two additional universal sources exist and cover every wearable: data/artifacts/loot_tables/entities/mimic.json rolls the artifacts:artifact table on every mimic kill, and data/artifacts/loot_tables/chests/campsite_chest.json rolls the same table in the underground campsite structure - note campsites and mimics only generate in chunks created after the mod was installed. Dropped ids: umbrella_blocking, umbrella_gui, umbrella_held_blocking, umbrella_held_idle and umbrella_idle (render-only models with no item./block. lang key, so they failed set-membership). Excluded from the chain but real items: artifacts:mimic_spawn_egg (creative-only spawn egg, no loot or recipe source), and artifacts:novelty_drinking_hat / artifacts:plastic_drinking_hat, which are only reachable through the artifacts:items/drinking_hat sub-table rolled inside artifacts:artifact rather than any named structure - they are kept as wheel members only. artifacts:artifact is a loot table id, not an item, and was deliberately not written as a quest id. No unverifiable ids were written.
